headline: A 2011 executive order set up a national plan focused on women's roles in peace and security efforts.
what_it_does: This order put in place a U.S. National Action Plan on Women, Peace, and Security. Based on the title alone, it directs the federal government to follow a plan about how women are included in and affected by peace and security work. No summary was provided, so the specific agencies, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on foreign policy, defense, and international aid
who_it_affects.how: They are likely expected to carry out parts of the national action plan, though the exact duties are not stated in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 19, 2011; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
